verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤਮ ਮਧਿਮ ਅਰੁ ਅਧਮ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਨੋ ਸੁਅੰਨੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੁਰੋ ਤਉ ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: autam madhim ar adham tirabidh jag aapano sua(n)n kaahoo buro tau na laag hai ||

en.bdb: Just as no category of society, high, middle or low class considers their son bad or evil,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੋਊ ਬਨਜੁ ਕਰਤ ਲਾਭ ਲਭਤ ਕਉ ਆਪਨੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਭਲੋ ਜਾਨਿ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabh kouoo banaj karat laabh labhat kau aapano biauhaar bhalo jaan anuraag hai ||

en.bdb: Just as everyone do business in order to earn profit, but they all consider their own profession to be the best and therefore love it,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਇਸਟੈ ਚਾਹਤ ਸਭੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਸਭ ਜਗਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: taise apane apane isaTai chaahat sabhai apane pahire sabh jagat sujaag hai ||

en.bdb: Similarly everyone respect and love their own deity and in their life-time, are ever ready and conscious of worshipping him,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਅੰਨੁ ਸਮਰਥ ਭਏ ਬਨਜੁ ਬਿਕਾਨੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਸਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥੫੫੨॥
verses.translit_en: sua(n)n samarath bhe banaj bikaane jaanai isaT prataap a(n)t kaal agrabhaag hai ||552||

en.bdb: Just as a son grows up to understand the art of trading and acquires proficiency, similarly a devoted disciple learns that the ambrosial name blessed by the True Guru can liberate from the noose of the angles of death at the final hour. (552)
